headline: Approved $300,000.00 in Davis Foundation grant spending and a $200,000.00 professional development contract renewal.
summary: Each item passed by a 7-0 roll call vote. Five new MASC conference resolutions were approved, along with three reauthorized 2023 MASC resolutions. Delegates were also authorized to vote on the resolutions at the November 2026 MASC Conference.
decisions: Approved $300,000.00 expenditure from the Davis Foundation for the Pathway to Prosperity grant, 7-0.
Approved renewal of City Contract No. 20260077 for $200,000.00, 7-0.
Approved 2026 MASC Conference Resolution No. 1 on Safe Zones, 7-0.
Approved 2026 MASC Conference Resolution No. 2 on vocational/technical representation on the state education board, 7-0.
Approved 2026 MASC Conference Resolution No. 3 on vocational/technical representation on the school building authority board, 7-0.
Approved 2026 MASC Conference Resolution No. 4 on seclusion standards in emergency behavioral response procedures, 7-0.
Approved 2026 MASC Conference Resolution No. 5 on special education reserve fund access by majority vote, 7-0.
Approved reauthorization of a 2023 MASC resolution on transportation bidding procedures, 7-0.
Approved reauthorization of a 2023 MASC resolution on full, stable funding for METCO, 7-0.
Approved reauthorization of a 2023 MASC resolution on MA School Building Authority assistance programs, 7-0.
Authorized the elected delegate and alternate to vote on MASC resolutions at the November 2026 conference, 7-0.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion passes to approve the expenditure of $300,000.00 from the Davis Foundation for the Pathway to Prosperity Bridging High School to Postsecondary Success Grant.

Motion passes to approve the Notice of Exercise of Renewal Option No. 1 for City Contract No. 20260077, Agreement for Professional Development Services for Springfield Public Schools, in the amount of $200,000.00.
Motion passes to approve the 2026 MASC Conference Resolution No. 1: Safe Zones.
Motion passes to approve the 2026 MASC Conference Resolution No. 2: Vocational/Technical Representation on the Massachusetts Board of Elementary and Secondary Education.
Motion passes to approve the 2026 MASC Conference Resolution No. 3: Vocational/Technical Representation on the Massachusetts School Building Authority Board.
Motion passes to approve the 2026 MASC Conference Resolution No. 4: Regarding Clarification of Seclusion Standards Within Emergency Behavioral Response Procedures (603 CMR 46.00).
Motion passes to approve the 2026 MASC Conference Resolution No. 5: Allowing Regional School Committees to Access Special Education Reserve Funds by a Majority Vote of the School Committee.
Motion passes to approve the Reauthorization of Previously Approved 2023 MASC Resolution Regarding Investigations and Recommendations for Transportation Bidding Procedures.
Motion passes to approve the Reauthorization of Previously Approved 2023 MASC Resolution Regarding Full, Stable Funding For METCO.
Motion passes to approve Reauthorization of Previously Approved 2023 MASC Resolution Regarding MA School Building Authority Assistance Programs.

Motion passes to authorize the elected Delegate/Alternate Delegate to vote on the Resolutions at the MASC Conference in November 2026, as may be amended at the 2026 MASC Conference, in accordance with the will of the School Committee.
